exposure: health policies implemented during the COVID-19 pandemic
outcome: stillbirth rates (absence of vital signs after 28 weeks)
cohort: The study analyzed data from 221,866 singleton pregnancies over 48 months (2018-2022) in a city in southern Iran.
finding: Inefficient pandemic-related health policies adversely affected birth weight outcomes and did not curb the continuing rise in preterm birth rates.
birth_weight: All birth weights from singleton pregnancies were included; low birth weight was defined as 1000-2500 g.
gest_age: All gestational ages from singleton pregnancies were included; preterm birth was defined as 28-37 weeks, and stillbirth after 28 weeks.
